items.summary: 简介 DLSS 5 是英伟达于 2026 年 3 月 16 日 GTC 大会发布的下一代 AI 渲染技术， 秋季正式上线。很多玩家都在问：我的显卡支持 DLSS 5 吗？ 我做了一个免费查询工具解答这个问题： 🔗 主要功能 显卡兼容性查询：输入显卡型号，立刻看到 DLSS 5 支持状态（已确认 / 可能 / 不太可能） 当前 DLSS 4/4.5 性能数据：展示各显卡在主流游戏中的 FPS 提升数据 版本对比表：DLSS 3 vs 4 vs 4.5 vs 5 的功能差异一览 支持 40+ 款显卡：覆盖 RTX 50/40/30/20、GTX 10、AMD、Intel 技术栈 Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Fuse.js（模糊搜索） 背景 DLSS 5 的核心功能是实时神经渲染（Realtime Neural Rendering）， 用 AI 实时生成光照和材质效果，而非此前版本的帧生成/超分辨率。 目前仅确认支持 RTX 50 系列，RTX 40 系列未官方确认， RTX 30/20 系列支持可能性较低。 独立开发，非 NVIDIA 官方，数据持续更新中
items.content:
## 简介

  DLSS 5 是英伟达于 2026 年 3 月 16 日 GTC 大会发布的下一代 AI 渲染技术，
  秋季正式上线。很多玩家都在问：我的显卡支持 DLSS 5 吗？

  我做了一个免费查询工具解答这个问题：

  🔗 https://dlss5.net

  ## 主要功能

  - **显卡兼容性查询**：输入显卡型号，立刻看到 DLSS 5 支持状态（已确认 / 可能 / 不太可能）
  - **当前 DLSS 4/4.5 性能数据**：展示各显卡在主流游戏中的 FPS 提升数据
  - **版本对比表**：DLSS 3 vs 4 vs 4.5 vs 5 的功能差异一览
  - **支持 40+ 款显卡**：覆盖 RTX 50/40/30/20、GTX 10、AMD、Intel

  ## 技术栈

  Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Fuse.js（模糊搜索）

  ## 背景

  DLSS 5 的核心功能是**实时神经渲染**（Real-time Neural Rendering），
  用 AI 实时生成光照和材质效果，而非此前版本的帧生成/超分辨率。
  目前仅确认支持 RTX 50 系列，RTX 40 系列未官方确认，
  RTX 30/20 系列支持可能性较低。

  独立开发，非 NVIDIA 官方，数据持续更新中

items.author: lifedever

items.content:
项目地址：https://github.com/lifedever/claude-rules

## 简介

用 AI 写代码时，AI 会模仿项目里已有的代码风格——包括坏习惯。claude-rules 给 AI 一套可执行的编码规范，核心原则：**不要模仿旧代码，按规范重构**。

和市面上那些"使用适当的错误处理"之类的空话规范不同，每条规则都具体到 AI 能直接执行，比如"函数不超过 30 行"、"基本类型用 ref，对象用 reactive，禁止解构 reactive"。

## 特点

- **base + language + framework 三层组合**，按需拼装
- 支持 10 种语言（TypeScript、Java、Go、Rust、Kotlin、Swift、Python 等）和 5 个框架（Vue、React、SwiftUI、Spring Boot、Tauri）
- 每条规则都有**禁止/正确的代码对比示例**
- Claude Code 用户可通过插件一键初始化，自动检测技术栈生成规范文件
- 同样适用于 Cursor、Windsurf、GitHub Copilot，规范是纯 Markdown 通用格式

items.content:
### 💡 为什么做这个工具？

平时工作写代码时经常需要瞄一眼股市行情，但又不想一直开着笨重的交易软件，也不希望界面太引人注目（懂的都懂）。虽然市面上有不少状态栏看盘工具，但总有一些痛点没被满足，比如：不支持美股盘前盘后行情、没有直观的分时图、或者需要去配置繁琐的 API Key。

### ✨ 核心功能

* **🌍 多市场全覆盖**：支持 A股（沪/深/北）、港股、美股实时行情。
* **📊 极简分时图**：点击列表里的任意股票，即可展开查看当天的分钟级分时走势。
* **🕒 美股全时段支持**：完美支持美股盘前、盘中、盘后及夜盘。分时图涵盖美东时间 04:00 – 20:00，并有清晰的交易时段标识。
* **💰 持仓盈亏追踪**：支持为自选股设置“成本价”和“持仓数量”，自动计算并展示你的实时浮动盈亏和当日盈亏。
* **🎨 自定义配色**：支持“红涨绿跌（A股习惯）”或“绿涨红跌（美股习惯）”一键切换。
* **⚡ 纯净无后端**：所有数据均通过新浪、腾讯、Yahoo Finance 的公开免费接口直连获取，无需注册账号，也无需任何 API Key 配置。

### 📸 界面预览

*(图注：点击状态栏图标即可展开自选股列表，点击任意股票即可查看分时图，支持美股盘前盘后及持仓盈亏展示)*

### 💻 运行环境

* macOS 13.5 (Ventura) 及以上系统。
* Universal 原生应用，完美兼容 Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3) 和 Intel 芯片。

### 🔗 获取与下载

项目完全开源，代码清爽，欢迎大家审查或者进行二次开发。如果你觉得还不错，希望能到 GitHub 给个 Star ⭐️ 支持一下！

* **安装包下载**：可直接前往仓库的 [Releases 页面](https://github.com/VGEAREN/Stockbar/releases) 下载最新的 `Stockbar.dmg`。

items.content:
1. Introduction to C Dance AI
C Dance AI is an online AI tool dedicated to high-quality cinematic video creation, committed to lowering the barriers of professional video production so that everyone can become a video director.
URL: https://cdance.ai/
Unlike traditional complex video editing software (e.g., Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro), C Dance AI leverages the advanced Seedance 2.0 generative video model. It can quickly generate smooth, audio-synced cinematic videos from simple text prompts, images, or reference clips—no advanced editing skills required. Whether for social media reels, product demos, or educational tutorials, users can easily create professional video content.
2. Core Features of C Dance AI
This tool offers a set of core features optimized for content creators and marketers:
Text/Image-to-Video Generation: The core function supports generating videos from text prompts, reference images, or existing clips. Just input "A cinematic drone shot of a coastal city at sunset" or upload a product photo, and the AI will produce a polished video in minutes.
Native Audio-Visual Sync: Eliminates post-editing work by automatically aligning audio and visuals, ensuring smooth, professional output without choppy motion or out-of-sync sound.
Diverse Cinematic Styles: Supports multiple visual styles (e.g., cinematic, documentary, commercial) and scene pacing, catering to different creative needs.
User-Friendly Interface: Abandons complex parameter adjustments. The intuitive web interface requires only a prompt and a click—zero learning curve for beginners.
High-Fidelity Video Output: Generates professional-grade videos with stable motion, clear visuals, and natural transitions, suitable for commercial use and social media sharing.
Flexible Pricing: Offers free trial credits for new users, with pay-as-you-go pricing to scale with your content needs.
3. Demo Showcase
Creation Example:
User input prompt: "A 15-second cinematic product demo for a wireless headphone, with soft lighting and smooth product rotation" (or upload a product photo).
Result: The system outputs a fully original, high-quality video that perfectly showcases the product’s design and features, with matching background music and seamless transitions—ready to be shared on e-commerce platforms or social media.
(Note: We recommend pasting a screenshot of the website interface or a generated video preview here to enhance visibility.)
4. How to Use C Dance AI
Creating cinematic videos with C Dance AI is simple—just 3 steps:
Visit the website: Open https://cdance.ai/.
Input your vision: Enter a text prompt, upload a reference image, or paste a video clip to guide the AI.
Generate with one click: Click the generate button, wait a few minutes, and you can preview or download your AI-generated video directly in the browser.
Start creating now: https://cdance.ai/

items.title: 【工具推荐】StoryMotion AI - 使用 AI 瞬间将创意转化为 Excalidraw 风格的动画视频
items.author: chunrapeepat
items.summary: Editor: Website:
items.content: Editor: https://storymotion.video/editor/ Website: https://storymotion.video/ 大约六个月前，我在[这份 newsletter 里分享了 StoryMotion](https://github.com/ruanyf/weekly/issues/7695)。它是一款用于制作讲解动画的动态图形编辑器，结合了 Excalidraw 的手绘风格和 Keynote 的易用性。 从那时起，我根据用户的反馈开发了许多新功能： * **Presentation Mode：** 直接在应用内流畅地演示你的动画。 * **Iframe Embeds：** 轻松将交互式动画直接嵌入到技术文档或博客文章中。 * **Editor-Wide Undo/Redo：** 一个呼声很高、能让编辑体验更顺滑的功能。 * **Timeline Folders：** 对动效时间轴上的元素进行分组和整理。 * **StoryMotion Cloud：** 一个用于保存和管理所有项目的集中枢纽。 * ……以及更多功能。 今天，我很高兴能向大家介绍我们最大的更新：StoryMotion AI。 * **AI Agent：** 只需拖入文档或参考图片，AI 就会自动为你生成 Excalidraw 风格的视觉内容。 [🎥 点击这里观看 AI Agent 演示视频 (YouTube)](https://youtu.be/dQNvEBybQlI) [![Watch the YouTube video](https://img.youtube.com/vi/dQNvEBybQlI/0.jpg)](https://youtu.be/dQNvEBybQlI) * **Magic Animate：** 自动为画布上的任何视觉元素分配动态效果。 [🎥 点击这里观看 Magic Animate 演示视频 (YouTube)](https://youtu.be/u1fTk19a_6Y) [![Watch the YouTube video](https://img.youtube.com/vi/u1fTk19a_6Y/0.jpg)](https://youtu.be/u1fTk19a_6Y) 用户仍然可以免费使用我们的编辑器，包含上述所有核心功能的完全访问权限（导出带有水印），外加 25 MB 的云存储空间和每月 15 个免费的 AI 积分，以便测试新的生成工具。 希望你喜欢这款工具，非常欢迎来自社区的任何反馈。 中文不是我的母语，如果写得不好，提前说声抱歉。

items.content: Research player props like a sharp bettor. DumbMoneyPicks analyzes player props using EV signals, line movement, injury role redistribution, and AI research summaries to help identify potential edges in betting markets.

items.title: OmegaIon
items.summary: AI-powered Elemental Map for environmental risk & solutions.
items.content: OmegaIon maps the pulse of the Earth. Leveraging AI, it translates news in eight languages ​​into seven environmental issue and environmental regulation attributes, visualizing over 95% of global environmental news. An intuitive dashboard allows you to understand global environmental risks, complex regulations, and discover green technology solutions. This system is based on patent-pending technology and built on 2.5 million prompts.

items.title: Lista
items.summary: A simple to-do list with GTD workflows + iCloud sync
items.content: Lista helps you stay organized and focused with a simple structure and built-in filters that work at any level — globally, within a space, or within a single list. Powerful GTD workflows, naturally, with no configuration required. Privacy is core — iCloud sync and collaboration, your data stays yours. Designed natively for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

items.title: Nuxt Charts
items.summary: Beautiful charts with Vue and Nuxt
items.content: Modern Vue charts and components to build beautiful dashboards. Built with Tailwind CSS and Nuxt UI.

items.title: SpeedDistanceCalculator.com
items.summary: Calculate Speed Distance Time of Your journey instantly
items.content: Time Speed Distance Calculator to find distance, speed or time using standard formulas. Supports km/h & m/s, km & meters, hours & seconds with step-by-step solution.

items.title: RepliFuse.ai
items.summary: AI Agents that turn comments into growth insights
items.content: Comment Intelligence platform powered by AI Agents. It helps brands and creators manage comments across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook by triaging urgent messages, spotting buying intent, flagging risk signals, and surfacing recurring audience insights—so teams respond faster, protect trust, and turn engagement into growth.

items.title: WPress2Astro
items.summary: Migrate your WordPress content to Astro in minutes
items.content: Convert your WordPress site to Astro with clean Markdown, Tailwind CSS, and a production-ready starter project.

items.title: ClawMetry Cloud
items.summary: See your OpenClaw agents' costs, activity & memory live
items.content: Your OpenClaw agent is running, but do you know what it's doing or how much it's costing? ClawMetry Cloud gives you live flow visualization, token costs, memory state, and sub-agent activity from any browser or Mac app. Two commands to connect: pip install clawmetry, then clawmetry connect. E2E encrypted, your data never touches our servers unencrypted. Open source locally, $5/node/month for cloud. 7-day free trial.

items.title: NexArt
items.summary: Make AI and software execution provable
items.content: Most systems can’t prove what actually ran. Logs help debugging, but they don’t provide verifiable execution. NexArt turns every execution into a Certified Execution Record (CER), a tamper-evident artifact that captures inputs, context, and outputs, and can be independently verified. Stop reconstructing events from logs. Start with proof.

items.title: Nexcerpts
items.summary: Capture anywhere. AI organizes your knowledge base.
items.content: Stop losing great ideas you find online. Nexcerpts captures text from any website, then AI organizes it into your knowledge base. Our capture-first workflow lets you save now, organize later. AI suggests where each note belongs, you review the plan, then one click organizes everything. Unlike Notion (manual) or Mem.ai (no control), you get AI assistance with human oversight. Perfect for researchers, students, and writers drowning in browser tabs and scattered notes.

items.title: Doccupine
items.summary: Open source AI-ready documentation platform.
items.content: Open source CLI turns your Markdown or MDX files into beautiful documentation. Bring your own AI model plus MCP support. Our hosted platform includes a visual editor, pending changes, custom domains, and team collaboration.

items.title: Fantastical MCP for Mac
items.summary: Manage your schedule directly with Claude
items.content: With the new Fantastical Claude Connector we're bringing scheduling right into your Claude conversation so you can plan and schedule without having to switch between apps!

items.title: SplitEven
items.summary: AI receipt scanner to split bills instantly.
items.content: Say goodbye to doing math at the dinner table. SplitEven is an AI-powered receipt scanner and bill splitter designed to make sharing expenses effortless. Snap a photo of your receipt, and our AI instantly extracts items, taxes, and tips. Assign items to friends with a tap and get a clean, shareable breakdown in seconds. Built by an indie dev to be a faster, modern alternative.

items.title: Claude Dispatch
items.summary: Text Claude from your phone using “Dispatch”
items.content: Message Claude from your phone. It runs on your desktop, touches your files, browses, builds reports, executes tasks. Sandboxed. Local. You approve before it acts. One persistent conversation.

items.title: Persyn.ai
items.summary: Create content without a camera
items.content: Create photos and videos of yourself or an AI persona without ever being on camera. Persyn turns a few photos into a full content studio. Choose from 50+ presets across TikTok UGC, Meta ads, Instagram stories, LinkedIn, dating, and more. Each piece generates in under 30 seconds using the world's best video models — Kling 3.0 Pro, Veo 3.1, GrokImagine, Seedance— all included on every plan. 20 free credits to start. 5 more every day. No card required.

items.title: Drippr — Price Tracker for Any Website
items.summary: Track prices on any website. Get notified when they drop.
items.content: Drippr is a Chrome extension that tracks product prices on any e-commerce website — no matter the site. Set a target price and get notified the moment it drops Beyond shopping, Drippr also lets you track stocks, gold, crypto, and currencies with a live portfolio dashboard, price history charts, and P&L tracking.Free plan: track up to 5 products with browser notifications. Pro ($1.99/mo): unlimited tracking, email alerts, and asset portfolio features.

items.title: My1ta
items.summary: AI turns scanned PDF exams into editable HWP files
items.content: Upload a scanned PDF exam. My1ta's AI recognizes math equations, tables, and diagrams, then converts into editable HWPX (Korea's standard word processor). No more manual retyping. Our AI even generates solutions when answer keys are missing. • AI OCR for math (fractions, integrals, matrices) • Direct HWPX output, no artifacts • Auto-generated answer keys • 10-min turnaround per exam Built for Korean teachers who spent hours retyping tests.

items.title: Navai
items.summary: AI travel designer italiano,itinerari con link in 15min
items.content: Navai è il primo AI travel designer italiano. Compili un form in 2 minuti con destinazione, date, budget e preferenze. In 15 minuti ricevi un itinerario completo e personalizzato con link di prenotazione pronti per voli, hotel e attrazioni. Non è un chatbot generico: è un documento strutturato con hotel confrontati (3-5 opzioni con pro e contro), timeline prenotazioni, piano B per imprevisti e budget dettagliato. A partire da €49 per viaggio. Nessun abbonamento.

items.title: Repoprep
items.summary: Turn your project folder into an AI-ready context file
items.content: RepoPrep converts your project folder or repo into a single AI-ready context file for tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini. It automatically filters out noise such as node_modules, lock files, build outputs, and binaries, leaving only relevant source code. Everything runs entirely in the browser — your code never leaves your machine.

items.title: StoryComic AI
items.summary: AI Comics with consistent characters - same face,every panel
items.content: StoryComic AI is the only AI comic generator that keeps your character looking identical across all panels. Problem: Midjourney and DALL-E create beautiful images, but every panel has a different face. Impossible to build a comic IP. Solution: Our Character Sheet technology creates a visual "DNA" for your character — same face, same clothes, same proportions in every single panel. Perfect for: • Instagram/TikTok comic creators • Webtoon artists • Content creators building their IP
